scope: Full upstream SLICOT FPM source library, linked to compatible LP64 BLAS/LAPACK with the manifest BLAS metapackage resolved explicitly. Sources are unchanged; legacy compiler compatibility flags retain upstream conventions. The main uses the author slicot module interface for SB03MD, constructs a stable nondiagonal 2-by-2 continuous Lyapunov problem from a known symmetric solution and checks both the independently computed matrix residual and the recovered solution including the solver scale factor. It requests the condition/error estimates but does not validate those estimates independently. Other matrix equations, model reduction, identification, robust control and every library routine are not validated.
